title: Finite residue-fibre cohomology from a strictly perfect neighbourhood
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E an object of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], and x a point of X. Suppose there is an open V containing x and a strictly perfect complex P [def-pc-perfect-complex] on V whose derived object is isomorphic to the restriction of E. For every integer i, the derived residue-fibre cohomology of E at x [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti] is finite-dimensional over the residue field of x.

proof.text: Choose a complex G representing E using essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q. Apply exists_localStrictPerfect_stalk_projective_model to the given local strictly perfect representative. Obtain a bounded complex L over the stalk ring with finite-projective terms and a derived comparison with the termwise stalk of G.

Finite projective modules over the local stalk ring are free (Mathlib Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing). The upper bound makes L strictly bounded above. Apply nonempty_stalkFree_residueCohomology_linearEquiv to identify each derived residue cohomology vector space with the homology of the termwise residue extension of L.

Module.Finite.base_change makes every residue tensor term finite-dimensional. For K equal to that residue extension, use (K.sc i).moduleCatHomologyIso to identify its homology with the quotient of the kernel of its outgoing differential by the image of its incoming differential into that kernel. The kernel is finite-dimensional as a subspace of K.X i, and its quotient is finite-dimensional by the Mathlib instances. Transfer finiteness first along moduleCatHomologyIso and then along the residue-cohomology linear equivalence using Module.Finite.equiv. No lower bound or rank positivity is needed in this calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFiberCohomology
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (x : X)
    (hlocal : ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ,
        IsStrictlyPerfect X V P ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (X.residueField x) (derivedFiberCohomology X E i x)
